THE DETAILS

Privacy

Your inputs stay in your browser.

Scope and tool inputs

This notice describes the current website, updated 21 October 2026. Text, images, generated passwords and calculation inputs are processed in your browser. The tool code does not upload those inputs, store them in a database or send them to an analytics service.

Hosting and access

The hosting platform may process request metadata, such as IP addresses, browser information and access logs, to deliver and secure the site. Hosting providers may use their own operational storage or cookies. Those platform activities are separate from local tool processing.

Cookies, analytics and advertising

This version does not include site-added advertising or analytics scripts and does not add tool-specific cookies. Hosting authentication may use its own storage or cookies. If analytics or advertising is introduced, this notice and applicable consent controls must be updated before activation.

Files and clipboard

Downloaded files are saved by your browser. Copy buttons write to your device clipboard when you request it. Toolnest does not read your clipboard. Reloading closes the current in-memory work; downloads and clipboard contents are controlled by your device.
